Behind it, out of focus, wooden chairs stacked upside down on tables, a half-lowered corrugated metal roll-up shutter at the entrance with blue street light coming through. Vertical 9:16 still frame from a premium cinematic TV commercial. 35mm lens, shallow depth of field, natural film grain, low-key practical lighting. Key subject placed between 15% and 55% of the frame height; the bottom third of the frame is calm dark negative space. No human faces, only hands when people appear.
